publication_text: Deloitte, explanatory letter to the Australian Department of Finance, September 2, 2025, FOI 25-26-084 Document 1, pp. 2–3. Approval of code analysis, publication uses, training, and partial review are statements by the provider. Official publicly released PDF.

DEWR and Deloitte, correspondence on the TCF Assurance Review, parliamentary public PDF, 11 pages, especially pp. 6–11. The date on the refund request letter differs by one day from the directory date, so the text uses “early September.” The correspondence checked cannot, on its own, establish receipt of the refund, final acceptance, or termination of the contract. The original refund hearing record has not yet been obtained in full; neither an actual receipt date nor the refund as a proportion of the contract amount is used. Parliamentary correspondence PDF.

CU President and campus Chancellors, “Update on planned ChatGPT Edu launch,” March 19, 2026. Joint university announcement. It records the arrangements for different user groups at that time, not evidence of actual go-live outcomes. University announcement.
